Website: https://wxundup.github.io/younesjabara-site/#ontask

ONTASK — the task list for https://wxundup.github.io/younesjabara-site/#ontask

You are an agent. A human asked you to use their OnTask list. This page is the
whole API. Every URL below is printed in full, on purpose: many fetch tools only
open URLs that already appear in the conversation, so copy these as-is instead
of building paths yourself.

ADDING A TASK — pick whichever is easiest:

1) POST https://younes-ontask.woundedmc.workers.dev/ontask/endpointforagent with JSON:
   {"title": "text sarah about the wedding photos", "date": "2026-10-15", "time": "17:00", "type": "task", "notes": "optional"}

2) GET https://younes-ontask.woundedmc.workers.dev/ontask/api/add?title=text%20sarah&date=tomorrow&time=5pm&type=task

3) POST https://younes-ontask.woundedmc.workers.dev/ontask/endpointforagent with raw text (no JSON):
   the whole body is the task. example body: tomorrow 5pm text sarah about the wedding photos

FIELDS
- title  required. a short action the human should do, like "text sarah about the wedding photos".
- date   "2026-10-15" (YYYY-MM-DD). also understood: today, tonight, tomorrow, friday,
         next friday, oct 15, in 3 days. if the human gave no date, omit it (task has no date).
- time   "17:00" or "5pm" or "5:30pm". optional.
- type   homework | school | event | task. default task.
         homework = assignments and studying, school = classes/exams, event = weddings,
         parties, flights, appointments, task = everything else (texting someone, shipping an update).
- notes  optional extra detail, max 2000 chars.

CHECK FOR DUPLICATES BEFORE YOU ADD
GET https://younes-ontask.woundedmc.workers.dev/ontask/api/tasks without filters, including completed tasks.
Match titles, dates, notes, and source links. Skip existing assignments even when
completed or renamed. Never reopen completed work or replace confirmed dates.
Prefer the connected MCP tools: list_tasks first, then add_task with a stable
source-derived id such as gmail-<message-id>. REST callers must check duplicates
themselves. Read the list again after writing and verify the saved task.

READING THE LIST — GET https://younes-ontask.woundedmc.workers.dev/ontask/api/tasks returns
{"ok":true,"tasks":[...]}. Filters, combine any of them on one request:
- from=2026-10-22&to=2026-10-28   date range. from/to also accept today, tomorrow,
                                  friday, oct 25, in 3 days — the words work here too.
- type=homework|school|event|task
- status=open|done                 open = not done yet
- q=whitman                        keyword search over titles and notes,
                                    best matches first. combine with the filters above.
example: GET https://younes-ontask.woundedmc.workers.dev/ontask/api/tasks?status=open&from=today&to=in%207%20days

MANAGING TASKS — you can edit and delete, not only add:
- PATCH  https://younes-ontask.woundedmc.workers.dev/ontask/api/tasks/:id   JSON body with the fields to change.
                                 {"done": true} marks it done; {"done": false} reopens it.
- DELETE https://younes-ontask.woundedmc.workers.dev/ontask/api/tasks/:id   removes the task. Deleting twice is fine.
The id is on every task in the list response.

RESPONSE
- 200 {"ok":true,...} means it worked. anything else means it failed; retry once at most.

RULES
- one request = one task. several tasks = several requests.
- resolve relative words ("tomorrow", "friday") to a real date yourself if you can;
  if you can't, send the word as-is — the server understands the common ones.
- unknown fields are ignored. missing date means no date. don't invent deadlines.

IF YOUR ENVIRONMENT BLOCKS THE CALLS
Agents run in sandboxes with network allowlists and fetch tools that refuse URLs
they have never seen. Work around it in this order:

1. Use your fetch tool on the full URLs printed on this page. They appear in the
   conversation now, so a fetch tool that only opens known URLs will take them.
   Ready-made examples:
   list    https://younes-ontask.woundedmc.workers.dev/ontask/api/tasks?status=open&from=2026-10-26&to=2026-11-08
   search  https://younes-ontask.woundedmc.workers.dev/ontask/api/tasks?q=algebra%20ii
   add     https://younes-ontask.woundedmc.workers.dev/ontask/api/add?title=Algebra%20II%20HW%20%2310&date=2026-10-26&type=homework
   mcp     https://younes-ontask.woundedmc.workers.dev/ontask/mcp  (JSON-RPC, tools: list_tasks, add_task)
2. If your sandbox shell cannot resolve younes-ontask.woundedmc.workers.dev, that is a blocked tool,
   not an API failure. Say which tool was blocked instead of reporting the API
   as unreachable.
3. If both are refused, hand the human the full add URL from example 2 above to
   click or paste back. Never claim tasks were added when no request went out.
GitHub Pages serves the website and llms.txt only. Send all API writes and MCP requests to https://younes-ontask.woundedmc.workers.dev/ontask.
